name: agent-loop
title_zh: 六段流水线跑完编码任务，每段独立上下文
tagline_zh: 复杂任务拆成六步走，每步独立上下文不串味。硬性迭代上限防死循环，文件交接让每阶段都看得见摸得着。
tagline_en: Break messy coding tasks into six staged passes, each with fresh context. Hard iteration caps stop loops; file.
desc_en: Run a coding task through a staged loop — triage, analyze, plan, implement, verify, debug — with file-based handoff between stages, a fresh context per stage, and hard iteration caps. Use only when the user explicitly invokes the loop by name (for example "/agent-loop <task>" or "run the agent loop on this"); it is deliberately heavier than a normal edit and should never be auto-selected for ordin
why_zh: 每阶段独立上下文，避免长对话记忆污染；文件交接让中间产物可审计；硬性迭代上限逼你在有限轮次内收敛。
why_en: Fresh context per stage prevents memory bleed; file-based handoffs make intermediates auditable; hard caps force convergence.
limit_zh: 必须显式用 /agent-loop 或「run the agent loop」调用，普通编辑不会触发。只覆盖编码任务。
limit_en: Only triggers on explicit /agent-loop or "run the agent loop" invocation—never auto-selected. Coding tasks only; outputs are files, not chat.
title_en: Six-stage coding loop with fresh context per stage
